evidence.quote: Buyer may deduct fifteen percent (15%) from the invoiced amount when payment is remitted within ten (10) days of the invoice date. No other deductions are authorized without Seller's prior written approval.

proposed_fix.description:
Dear Summit Retail Group Accounts Payable Team,

Thank you for your payment of $105,327 on 2026-06-20 against Invoice INV-2107 (PO ORD-0993, invoice total $126,900).

We confirm that your payment date falls within the 10-day early-pay window (invoice issued 2026-06-12), entitling you to a 15% discount per Contract Clause 4.2. The authorized deduction is $126,900 × 15% = $19,035.00. However, the deduction applied was $21,573.00, which is $2,538.00 in excess of the contractual allowance (17.0% vs. 15.0%).

Please remit the outstanding balance of $2,538.00 at your earliest convenience. If you believe this deduction was taken in error or have supporting documentation, please contact us so we can resolve this promptly.

Thank you for your partnership.

Best regards,
Accounts Receivable Team

verdict.explanation: Summit Retail Group's payment date of 2026-06-20 is within 10 days of the invoice date of 2026-06-12, so the early-pay discount is legitimately triggered under Clause 4.2. However, the discount taken is 17.0% ($21,573) rather than the contractual maximum of 15% ($19,035). The arithmetic excess is $2,538 (2.0 percentage points over the cap). The payment should have been $126,900 × 85% = $107,865; only $105,327 was remitted. A dispute note and corrective patch have been drafted for the $2,538 balance due.
